nina-sales: Quick sync  Prospect: MeridianTrust wants a 7-day POC. Must-haves: Okta SSO (SP-initiated), SCIM for users+groups, RBAC mapping, and domain verification across three subdomains under client-managed DNS. They sent a security questionnaire. Need answers: SCIM delta vs bulk, SCIM rate limits for POC, domain TXT flow and if delegated admin can manage claims, and a POC pricing pointer. @leo-se @priya-eng

leo-se: Got it. TL;DR: We support SAML SP-initiated + IdP metadata ingestion. SCIM 2.0: bulk endpoint for seeding + PATCH-based delta for incremental updates. Group->role mapping supported. We can set an allowlist so only specific Okta groups provision roles.

priya-eng: SCIM detail: delta uses PATCH ops and only changed resources are returned in the feed. For migrations we recommend: 1) bulk import to seed (paged), 2) enable delta for live updates. Hosted default throttle is 60 req/s; we can raise that for short POCs if ops approves. Example PATCH payload we accept provided in docs. Also watch SAML assertion size if they send many groups. SCIM is safer for large group sets.

mike-ops: Domain claim: we generate per-domain TXT tokens. Customer adds DNS TXT for each subdomain. If they control parent zone and want fewer tokens we can offer an ops-approved consolidated TXT for subdomains under the same zone, but not wildcard apex claims. Verification usually clears in minutes after propagation; schedule buffer of 24h. Delegated tenant admins can be granted permission to request claims; final verification step may require we run the check depending on Hosted vs Dedicated.

amy-legal: Security packet: send SOC2 Type II, pen test summary, encryption-at-rest + KMS note, network isolation doc for Dedicated, SAML endpoints and SCIM scope/retention. We'll answer their questionnaire; flag any ISA/DPA asks that need legal redlines.

nina-sales: Good. Pricing: can we offer Hosted elevated-quotas or a short Dedicated trial? Client prefers Dedicated if costs reasonable.

mike-ops: Two options: Hosted with credits and raised quotas (fast) or a 7-day Dedicated trial at a flat daily rate. For their expected POC scale (light concurrency, about ~80k tokens/day) estimate: $2k/week on Dedicated trial; I'll confirm with sales ops.

leo-se: Ops note: if Okta sends nested groups that increase assertion size, recommend turning off group claims and using SCIM group sync instead. Also recommend they send sample IdP metadata and one test user + group mapping ahead of kickoff.

calendar-bot: Created invite "MeridianTrust POC kickoff  SSO & SCIM" Tue 11:00 AM (30m) with #sales, @leo-se, @priya-eng, @amy-legal.

nina-sales: I'll ask them for IdP metadata URL/XML, a filled security questionnaire, list of domains, and a sample SCIM token/test user. Will follow up with formal quote EOD. :thumbsup:
